Fix `packages/common/src/colors.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:app --watch=false: 18 test files fail to load (e.g. packages/common/src/appEventBus.test.ts, packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts, packages/utils/tests/geometry.test.ts) with `TypeError: (0 , clamp) is not a function` at `cssInvert packages/common/src/colors.ts:65:13`, called from `packages/common/src/colors.ts:116:15` during module evaluation (`packages/common/src/index.ts:3:1`). The new code runs cssInvert at import time (top-level evaluation, e.g. building the invert pre-image table eagerly). `clamp` comes from `@excalidraw/math`, which imports `@excalidraw/common` back, so in that import cycle clamp is not yet initialised when colors.ts is evaluated. Fix: nothing in colors.ts may call cssInvert, clamp or any @excalidraw/math export at module top level; build the pre-image table lazily on the first reverseDarkModeFilter call (memoised in a module-level `let`), keeping the function's behaviour and its constant bound unchanged. Before this run, all 121 test files loaded and passed.
